title: Scalar comparison on one specified vector-bundle frame
statement: Let A and B be finite commutative rings, φ:A→B a unital ring map, and N>0 a common annihilator. Assume for every Noetherian scheme T with N invertible and every d≥0 that the specified ordered affine trace scalar square commutes, using [def-pur-vector-trace-scalar-map-data]. Let S be such a scheme, F a locally free module sheaf of rank r≥0, V an open subscheme of S, and e a specified trivialization of F on V [def-asd-vector-bundle-zero-section]. The two derived maps Q_S(vectorIntegrationSource_A)→ordinaryFiniteUnit_B given by vectorScalar ≫ vectorBundleIntegration_B and Q_S(vectorBundleIntegration_A) ≫ unit have equal images under ordinaryFinitePullback B V.ι. All maps are those of [def-amb-vector-integration] and the canonical comparison definitions. This asserts equality only after this single framed open restriction; detection of global equality is not part of this statement.

source.place: Paragraph 2: coefficient compatibility, projective Kummer normalization, affine induction and bundle-frame descent.

proof.text: Fix the normalized identifications throughout. The scalar functor is exact, and its tensor and composition comparisons are the K-flat comparisons. By the Tate normalization, $l_{T,0}=u_T$, $l_{T,1}$ is the balanced map, and $l_{T,d}$ is its tensor power with the prescribed shift. Thus the maps called $\theta^0,\theta^1[2]$ in the Kummer scalar lemma are precisely $u_T,l_{T,1}$ here: both send $(z\otimes a)\otimes b$ to $z\otimes\varphi(a)b$. The symmetric monoidal composition comparisons identify the two successive scalar extensions from $\mathbf Z/N$ with extension to $A'$; no ordinary tensor exactness along $A\to A'$ is being asserted. The Tate sheaves themselves are flat of rank one, so their derived extensions are the displayed shifted degree-zero sheaves. This also shows that every Tate input and its scalar extension used below is bounded below. The maps $l_{T,r}$ also commute with inverse image: for $f:X\to Y$, under the scalar/pullback comparison and the canonical Tate pullback identifications $f^{-1}A_Y(r)\cong A_X(r)$, $f^{-1}A'_Y(r)\cong A'_X(r)$ of [lem-asd-etale-finite-twist-pullback], $f^*(l_{Y,r})$ equals $l_{X,r}$. Both sides are maps between shifted flat degree-zero sheaves, computed by the degree-zero resolutions; on such K-flat objects the scalar/pullback comparison is the ordinary module pullback of the tensor product [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback], and the sheaf formula $(z\otimes a)\otimes b\mapsto z\otimes\varphi(a)b$ is preserved by inverse image of sections. Full faithfulness of the degree-zero embedding [lem-weil-pbc-derived-single-fully-faithful] turns this equality of sheaf maps into the derived equality. This proves the pullback compatibility needed on the specified frame.

proof.text: Fix the one specified frame e of F over the open V. Use it for both coefficient rings. V is Noetherian and N remains invertible. By vector-integration normalization, the restriction of each global trace is exactly the ordered affine trace after inverse-frame compact exchange and the normalized Tate pullback identification. The open-restriction square in compact scalar coherence and the pullback compatibility established in Step 1 identify the restricted vector scalar map with the local scalar map. For the frame coordinate isomorphism, transport the chosen compactification along the Cartesian square over the identity of V. Proper direct-image scalar exchange and open scalar exchange identify this transported proper/open scalar map with the affine-space map. Refinement coherence removes dependence on the transported compactification. Apply the assumed affine scalar equation over V in dimension r, and transport back through these specified identifications. This proves exactly the displayed equality after ordinaryFinitePullback B V.ι. No detection of global derived morphisms is asserted.

lean.statement:
theorem frame_scalar_square (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (φ : A →+* B)
    (hA : (N : A) = 0) (hB : (N : B) = 0)
    (ha : ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian T] (hT : IsUnit (N : Γ(T, ⊤)))
      (d : ℕ), affine φ N hN hA hB T hT d ≫ affineTrace N hN B hB T hT d =
        (scalarExtension φ T).map (affineTrace N hN A hA T hT d) ≫ unit φ T)
    (S : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian S] (hS : IsUnit (N : Γ(S, ⊤)))
    (r : ℕ) (F : SheafOfModules.{u} S.ringCatSheaf) [F.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank r]
    (V : S.Opens) (e : VectorBundleZeroSection.Trivialization S r F V) :
    (ordinaryFinitePullback B V.ι).map
        (vector φ N hN hA hB S hS r F ≫ vectorBundleIntegration N hN B hB S hS r F) =
      (ordinaryFinitePullback B V.ι).map
        ((scalarExtension φ S).map (vectorBundleIntegration N hN A hA S hS r F) ≫
          unit φ S)
